description: This file is a shell script used for testing Git attributes functionality, including attribute checking, pattern matching, source handling, and edge cases in a Git repository. It contains test functions, setup routines, and expectations for various attribute scenarios.

methods.name: attr_check_basic
methods.description: Checks the basic attribute for a given path, expecting a specific attribute value, running 'git check-attr' and comparing output.

methods.name: attr_check
methods.description: Performs attribute check and verifies no errors occurred.

methods.name: attr_check_object_mode_basic
methods.description: Checks the object mode attribute for a given path, calling 'git check-attr' with 'builtin_objectmode'.

methods.name: attr_check_object_mode
methods.description: Performs object mode attribute check and verifies no errors occurred.

methods.name: attr_check_quote
methods.description: Checks attribute with quoted path, ensuring quoting is handled correctly.

methods.name: attr_check_source
methods.description: Checks attribute with specific source, testing various 'git check-attr' source options and environment variables.
